MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small super glue tubes felt closest to my practical hardware purchases because they could help with an occasional small repair, though I would still wait until I needed them.",
    "The recommendations picked up on my interest in useful equipment, but that connection alone did not make most items relevant today."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Inspection cameras, electrical testers and thermometers require specific tasks that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "Printer filament assumes I own and use a 3D printer, while my purchases only show interest in fasteners and magnetic hooks.",
    "Bulk specialized glue, dust collection equipment, examination gloves and a safety can involve needs or quantities I have not shown."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying hardware seems to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop supply.",
    "My screws and washers appear to have been treated as evidence of broader technical hobbies, without a clear connection to their actual use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases cluster around fastening and hanging, particularly magnetic hooks; those uses matter more to me than a broad connection to tools.",
    "I buy infrequently and need a concrete reason to act, so even a plausible small repair supply is something I would skip without a current repair.",
    "Useful quantities and compatibility matter: small adhesive tubes seem more plausible than a large specialized refill, and supplies for equipment I have not shown I own are a stretch."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical hardware interest but stretched it into unrelated equipment and supplies without enough evidence of a current need."
}
